sections.description: The core bridge between Exacoat Manager ERP, WooCommerce orders, custom status, and fulfillment tracking.
sections.changelog:
### Version 0.1.86
- Resolved REST API authentication permissions for manager workstation migration operations
- Enforced active-only creator filter during SliceWP data migration (skipping pending and rejected)
- Enriched commission records with real-time WooCommerce order subtotal, delivery status, and customer attribution
- Universal ?x={slug} referral tracking with 30-day attribution window and backwards-compatible legacy link support
